basic.name: Arcane Rift
basic.description:
Launch a rift that deals 170~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in its path. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds and refund 50 Mana.

Quest: Hit 40 enemy Heroes with Arcane Rift without dying.

Reward: Permanently increase the damage dealt by 75 and cooldown reduction for hitting a Hero by 1 second.

basic.name: Force of Will
basic.description: Protect an allied Hero from all damage for 1.5 seconds. Upon expiration, Force of Will heals the target for 20% of the damage it absorbed.

basic.name: Portal
basic.description: Create a set of portals between Medivh and the target location, allowing allies to teleport between both. The portals last 6 seconds.

heroic.name: Poly Bomb
heroic.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

heroic.name: Ley Line Seal
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

heroic.name: Redirect Ley Line Seal
heroic.description: Redirect the energy wave to a new location.

trait.name: Raven Form
trait.description: Instead of mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over all terrain and is immune to all effects.

mount.name: Raven Form
mount.description: Transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over terrain and is immune to all effects.

activable.name: Portal
activable.description:
Create a Portal entrance or exit at the targeted location. 

Activate Medivh's Trait to cancel an unlinked Portal.

activable.name: Dust of Appearance
activable.description:
Activate to greatly increase sight range for 5 seconds and reveal enemy Heroes in the area for 8 seconds. Does not cancel Raven Form.

Passive: Increase Medivh's sight range while in Raven Form by 25%.

activable.name: Arcane Brilliance
activable.description: Activate to instantly restore 200 mana to all nearby allied Heroes and grant them 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

activable.name: Dust of Disappearance
activable.description:
Stealth an allied Hero for 40 seconds, they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Stores up to 2 charges.

level1.name: Winds of Celerity
level1.description: Increases Raven Form's Movement Speed bonus by 100%.

level1.name: Raven’s Intellect
level1.description: Raven Form increases Medivh's Mana and Health Regeneration by 200%.

level1.name: Portal Mastery
level1.description:
Medivh can manually place both Portal locations and it no longer breaks Raven Form. 

Activate Medivh's Trait to cancel an unlinked Portal.

level4.name: Mage Armor
level4.description: The first time an ally uses a Portal, they gain 40 Armor for 5 seconds, reducing their damage taken by 40%.

level4.name: Raven Familiar
level4.description: A Raven Familiar joins allies each time they use a Portal. The Raven will dive at the ally's next Basic Attack against a Hero within 5 seconds, dealing 114~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing them by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level4.name: Dust of Appearance
level4.description:
Activate to greatly increase sight range for 5 seconds and reveal enemy Heroes in the area for 8 seconds. Does not cancel Raven Form.

Passive: Increase Medivh's sight range while in Raven Form by 25%.

level7.name: Mystic Assault
level7.description: If Arcane Rift hits an enemy Hero, Medivh's next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 50% more damage and heals for 50% of the damage dealt.

level7.name: Arcane Explosion
level7.description: When Force of Will expires, it deals 80~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies, plus 50% of the damage it prevented, up to 315~~0.04~~ additional damage.

level7.name: Force of Magic
level7.description: Preventing at least 268~~0.04~~ damage with a single cast of Force of Will grants 35% Spell Power for 15 seconds. Stacks up to 2 times.

level10.name: Poly Bomb
level10.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.

level10.name: Ley Line Seal
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Circle of Protection
level13.description: Force of Will also applies to allies near the target.

level13.name: Enduring Will
level13.description: Preventing at least 268~~0.04~~ damage with Force of Will reduces its cooldown to 4 seconds.

level13.name: Reabsorption
level13.description: Increase the amount of healing from Force of Will to 70% of the damage it absorbed.

level16.name: Arcane Charge
level16.description: When Arcane Rift damages an enemy Hero, the next Arcane Rift deals 15% more damage.

level16.name: Temporal Flux
level16.description: Basic Attacks reduce Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 3%. Each enemy Hero hit by Arcane Rift reduces Medivh's Heroic Ability cooldown by 9%.

level16.name: Stable Portal
level16.description: Decrease Portal cooldown by 25% and increase Portal duration by 50%.

level20.name: Glyph Of Poly Bomb
level20.description:
Poly Bomb now hits an area, instantly Polymorphing enemy Heroes, hitting the same area again 1 second later.

Poly Bomb's duration is reduced to 1 second, and the spread radius is increased by 25%.

level20.name: Medivh Cheats!
level20.description: Increase the duration of the Time Stop by 33% and gain the ability to redirect the wave once while it's active.

level20.name: Guardian of Tirisfal
level20.description: Minions and Catapults hit by Arcane Rift are instantly killed.  Range is increased by 50%.

level20.name: Arcane Brilliance
level20.description: Activate to instantly restore 200 mana to all nearby allied Heroes and grant them 15% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

level20.name: Dust of Disappearance
level20.description:
Stealth an allied Hero for 40 seconds, they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

Stores up to 2 charges.
